_about: Proposed project settings for the SCBOT crew guard. Inert here: Claude Code reads settings only from .claude/. `python tools/scbot.py install` merges this into .claude/settings.json and writes each hook's command itself: the absolute path of the Python that ran install, and a launcher (-I -S -c, marked scbot-guard-hook) that runs the installed copy at the absolute path of .claude/scbot/bin/scbot.py and cannot exit with code 2, so a missing script blocks nothing. See prompts/SCBOT-README.md.
